def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if 5 in g[r]]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if any(g[r][c]==5 for r in range(h))]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    half_r=(r1-r0-1)//2; half_c=(c1-c0-1)//2
    # each marker: quadrant side by position
    import json
    fills={}
    for r,c,col in marks:
        top = r < (r0+r1)/2
        fills[col]=top  # marker's vertical half
    # assign: quadrant gets color of marker whose vertical half matches, horizontal half matches
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            top = r-r0-1 < half_r; left = c-c0-1 < half_c
            for r2,c2,col in marks:
                mtop = r2 < (r0+r1)/2; mleft = c2 < (c0+c1)/2
                # marker fills its own quadrant or diagonal opposite
                if (mtop==top) == (mleft==left):
                    out[r][c]=col
    return out
